en.t: I searched for where people were.

units.source_text: 要到海滨去，倒是有一颀低售而下的小径。

en.t: To get to the seashore, there was a little path slanting downward.

units.source_text: 我这才知道，那里正在勉强从事一项护岸工程，阻止严重的海水浸蚀。

en.t: Only then did I realize that they were struggling there with a shore-protection project to hold back the severe erosion by seawater.

units.source_text: 四处东倒西歪地躺着钢筋水泥柱子，活像一堆堆白骨。

en.t: Reinforced concrete pillars lay crookedly here and there, just like heaps of white bones.

units.source_text: 沙堆上这些新的钢筋水泥柱的颜色，显得格外有生气。

en.t: The color of these new reinforced concrete pillars on the sand piles looked especially vivid.

units.source_text: 震颤的微弱的声音，原来是震动倒人模子的水泥所发出的搅拌机的声音。

en.t: The faint trembling sound turned out to be the sound of a mixer vibrating the cement that had been poured into the molds.

units.source_text: 四五个鼻头通红的工人，带着惊讶的神色望了望身穿学生服的我。

en.t: Four or five workers with red noses looked at me in my student uniform with surprised expressions.
